title: Pin the unsupported-test notice variant for force-exit negative forms
outcome: The force-exit negative tests distinguish the unsupported-test notice from other feedback instead of relying only on a flag appearing in an echoed command.
acceptance: The negative-form regression asserts the exact unsupported-test notice or its distinguishing test-intent wording for each invalid flag form, while still verifying that no Test check is admitted.
The focused Node recognition tests pass without widening accepted production syntax or weakening existing artifact/count/source/grant guards.
